title: Table Pattern · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Table Pattern · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner draws a simple pattern of four marks, then covers it after a brief look. The lead recreates the pattern on another part of the paper. The recreated pattern matches the order and arrangement of marks. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Table Pattern, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The recreated pattern matches the order and arrangement of marks.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The recreated pattern matches the order and arrangement of marks.
